summary: Iovance Biotherapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on October 5, 2026, disclosing that it updated its corporate presentation for use at healthcare conferences and with analysts, current stockholders, and others. The October 2026 deck was furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference; no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date is stated. The filing includes only forward-looking-statement legends and standard signature by Interim CEO, President and General Counsel Frederick G. Vogt, confirming no special-situation event.
